title: Miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a vertex type $V$. For vertices $t,s\in V$ and an integer $k\ge 0$, the miss probability is one minus the hit probability for $t$, $k$, and $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
